tree.name: MoE
tree.cap: Reference architecture: 8× total parameters per active one

tree.name: Dense
tree.cap: Every parameter works on every token: −0.3 OOM effective compute against MoE for the same training FLOP
tree.cost: No 8× memory: total parameters = active ones

tree.name: Quality filter
tree.cap: Drops the worst quarter of crawled and usage text: the tokens you train on are better, but you have fewer unique ones, so a big base repeats its data sooner

tree.name: Code & math data
tree.cap: Trains on more code (×3), math and research papers (×2) and security text (×1.5) than you hold: stronger CODE, REASON, RSCH; weaker elsewhere; short domains repeat sooner

tree.name: Scaling recipes
tree.cap: Architecture and compute rebalancing at scale: pretraining efficiency (OOM); grows with run FLOP
tree.payoff: Most measured algorithmic progress is scale-dependent (Gundlach et al.)

tree.name: Data filtering & mixing
tree.cap: Better data for the same tokens: pretraining efficiency (OOM)

tree.name: Optimizer & architecture tweaks
tree.cap: Small scale-invariant gains: pretraining efficiency (OOM); a quarter of small-scale wins survive at scale

tree.name: Recurrent architectures
tree.cap: A fresh pool opened by neuralese recurrence: pretraining efficiency (OOM)

tree.name: Science data
tree.cap: Trains on more biology (×3), math and research (×1.5): stronger BIO, REASON, RSCH; weaker elsewhere
tree.saf: More bio capability: higher misuse uplift

tree.name: Native multimodal
tree.cap: Trains on more images, video and physical data (×3) and screens and actions (×2): stronger MEDIA, PHYS, AGENCY; weaker elsewhere

tree.name: Fault-tolerant training
tree.cap: Checkpointing and restarts: part of the 0.90 goodput every lab has

tree.name: Elastic training
tree.cap: Training throughput +0.023 OOM (goodput 0.90 → 0.95)

tree.name: Synthetic data flywheel
tree.cap: Generated data can beat web text: the quality ceiling of synthetic data rises from the web's 1 to 1.5 (strong teachers, rephrasing, filtering), and you can train on a synthetic-heavy mix
tree.payoff: Pays off with a teacher well above V0 (quality 1 at +2 OOM, 1.5 at +4 OOM)

tree.name: Long-horizon human demos
tree.cap: Experts can record days-long work for your long-tasks suite: a demonstrations build (Suites tab) adds their demos, raising its fidelity, its RL ceiling and so the time horizon
tree.cost: Research costs no cash; each demonstrations build buys its own expert data

tree.name: Faithful-CoT architecture
tree.cap: −0.29 OOM effective compute (faithful reasoning option)
tree.saf: Monitorability 0.98; halves CoT pressure and CoT controllability

tree.name: Neuralese recurrence
tree.cap: +0.5 OOM effective compute on a latent base

tree.name: AI-designed successor
tree.cap: AI-designed architecture and recipe: pretraining efficiency ≈ +1 OOM (wide uncertainty) for bases trained after adoption
tree.saf: New lineage: traits redrawn, tools may not transfer

tree.cap: Baseline reasoning (reasoning RL)

tree.cap: Baseline agents
